heading: Thursday Night
text: Mostly cloudy. Scattered early showers; slight chance after midnight east of the Greens. Lows from the mid 50s to around 60, cooler hollows in the lower 50s. Winds becoming northwest 5 to 10 mph.

heading: Friday
text: Partly to mostly sunny. Highs from the upper 60s to mid 70s in the south, and mid 60s to around 70 north, with some lower 60s northeast and in the Adirondacks. Northwest winds 10 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph.

heading: Friday Night
text: Clear to partly cloudy. Patchy valley fog. Lows from the upper 30s to mid 40s, except low to mid 30s in northern cold hollows, and some upper 40s in the broad valleys west. North to northwest winds 5 to 15 mph, becoming 5 mph or less in sheltered valleys.
